age_gate.question:
Hi! I’m *AstroDaily* bot 🌌

Before we start, I need to confirm that you are *18+* and that you understand this is *not a medical, financial or legal service* and is provided *for entertainment purposes only*.

Do you confirm that you are 18+ and agree with this?
age_gate.accepted:
Thank you! ✅

Let’s set up your profile.
Please send your birth date in format *DD.MM.YYYY*.
age_gate.declined:
Understood. AstroDaily is available only for users 18+.
If this was a mistake, you can send /start again later.

start.ask_birth_date:
Let’s set up your profile.
Please send your birth date in format *DD.MM.YYYY*.
start.welcome:
Hi! I’m your *{bot_name}* bot.

I’ll compute your natal chart and today’s transits and send you a short AI-powered astro digest based on your birth data and current sky events.

Use /today to get your digest for today.
Use /snooze to pause/resume daily delivery.
Use /help to see what I can do and all commands.

Now send your birth time in format *HH:MM* (24h), or type *Don’t know* if you’re not sure.

delivery_time.choose: Elige la hora de tu resumen diario:

general_balance.body: Today the sky looks relatively calm. This is a good moment to move through your routines without pressure, paying attention to small details and your natural pace. Gentle corrections will work better than radical moves.
general_balance.copy_short: A calm day to rebalance your basics — sleep, food, body, inbox, simple conversations. Small honest steps count more than big promises.
general_balance.copy_long: Astrologically the day doesn't push for dramatic turns, which is a gift: you can quietly realign areas that slipped out of balance. Focus on foundations — rest, simple tasks, practical money questions, realistic planning. If emotions rise, give them space, but don't let them steer the whole story.
general_balance.cta: Pick one tiny, realistic action that will make the rest of the week easier, and do it mindfully.

general_selfcare.body: The overall tone of the day is more about recovery than rush. Your system will respond well to softer pacing and honest rest.
general_selfcare.copy_short: Slow the tempo a little. Clear one small obligation, then give yourself permission to exhale and recharge.
general_selfcare.copy_long: Energy is better suited for restoration than for heroic breakthroughs. Lower the internal volume of 'must do everything right now'. Short pauses, walks, stretching, journaling or quiet time without screens can help your nervous system reset and make later decisions clearer.
general_selfcare.cta: Schedule at least one concrete self-care pause today — even 10–15 minutes — and treat it as a real appointment.

work_focus.body: Today is good for structured effort. Even if motivation comes in waves, you can make solid progress by breaking tasks into small, concrete steps.
work_focus.copy_short: Choose one key task and protect time for it. Close at least one loop at work instead of trying to multitask everything at once.
work_focus.copy_long:
The day supports practical, grounded actions in your work or projects. You don't need a heroic breakthrough — consistent, realistic effort will bring more result than chaotic activity. Focus on what is truly under your control: clear communication, honest priorities, and finishing what you start.

If tension grows, don't numb it with endless scrolling. Take a short break, move your body a little, and then return to the one thing that matters most today.
work_focus.cta: Write down the single most important task for today and commit to moving it forward at least by one clear step.

money_focus.body: Your attention towards money and resources can be especially productive now. It's a good moment to check numbers instead of guessing by mood.
money_focus.copy_short: Look at your real numbers: income, expenses, small leaks. Clarity reduces anxiety better than ignoring the topic.
money_focus.copy_long:
Astrologically the day supports practical steps in finances: revising a budget, checking subscriptions, renegotiating a small agreement, or finally sending that invoice. Small corrections here can have a long-term effect.

Try not to dramatise temporary fluctuations. Focus on decisions that are in your hands and on habits that make you feel safer, not just richer on paper.
money_focus.cta: Pick one small financial action (cancel a useless subscription, send an invoice, move a tiny sum to savings) and complete it today.

love_vibes.body: Connections with other people may feel more visible today — both the warm parts and the sensitive ones. This is a good time for honest but gentle conversations.
love_vibes.copy_short: Add a little warmth: a simple message, a sincere thank you, or a short check-in with someone you care about.
love_vibes.copy_long:
You may notice more clearly what nourishes you in relationships and what drains you. Instead of going into blame or self-criticism, try a curious approach: what kind of contact actually helps you feel safe and seen?

This is a good day to say something kind out loud, to listen without rushing to give advice, or to gently name your own needs without accusations.
love_vibes.cta: Reach out to one person who matters to you — with a short, honest message or a small gesture of attention.

selfcare_nervous_system.body: Your nervous system may be asking for a softer rhythm. Even a busy day can become kinder if you build in a few intentional pauses.
selfcare_nervous_system.copy_short: Give your body one clear signal of safety today: slow breath, warm tea, stretch, or a short walk without your phone.
selfcare_nervous_system.copy_long:
Stress sometimes feels like a permanent background noise, but your body still responds to small signals of care. You don't have to radically change your life in one day. Start with tiny adjustments: a slower cup of coffee, a few minutes with your shoulders relaxed, saying 'no' to one unnecessary task.

The goal is not perfection, but a slightly kinder baseline for your system.
selfcare_nervous_system.cta: Choose one small ritual that calms your nervous system and deliberately include it in today's schedule.
